posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 8-1. A massive win with home runs from Springer, Guerrero and Okamoto. The Guardians are late in their game and a Cleveland win would keep Toronto 1.0 game back. They’re 75-75.
posts.jp: ブルージェイズが8-1で勝利。スプリンガー、ゲレーロ、岡本和真のホームランで大勝。ガーディアンズの試合は遅延中で、クリーブランドの勝利でトロントは1.0ゲーム差を保つ。75-75。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: The Blue Jays have hit three consecutive homers off Trevor Rogers. The third in a group that includes George Springer and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is Kazuma Okamoto. 4-1 in a hurry
posts.jp: ブルージェイズはトレバー・ロジャースから連続3本のホームランを放つ。スプリンガーとゲレーロJr.を含むシリーズの3本目が岡本和真。4-1とリード。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: He's done it. Vladimir Guerrero Jr., in the 150th game of the season, has his 1st home run at Rogers Centre. He watched every second of it before he took a step. #BlueJays

reply_texts.text:
I had honestly resigned myself to it not happening this year.
Happy he showed me wrong.

reply_texts.text: Big finish now, come on Vladdy!
reply_texts.author: thegrumpypenguin.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Finally! ❤️. Hope this takes all pressure off of him … let’s go Vladdy!
reply_texts.author: northbaymoe.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: The monkey is off his back & if those 3 get/stay hot we got a chance.
reply_texts.author: homechef31.bsky.social

posts.jp: ウラジミール・ゲレーロJr.が今季150試合目でロジャーズセンターでの初ホームランを放つ。打球を最後まで見つめてから走塁。

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: The only other pitcher in Red Sox history with an immaculate inning in the first inning? Pedro Martinez. On Payton Tolle's impressive feat www.nytimes.com/athletic/759...
posts.jp: レッドソックス史上、1回表で完璧な回を記録した投手はペドロ・マルティネスのみ。ペイトン・トールの快挙。

posts.author: Jen McCaffrey
posts.text: Tolle is done for the day. An immaculate first inning and 22 swings and misses. That's second-most of any Sox pitcher this year. Tolle's 24 swing/miss on Aug. 7 are the most. 6 IP, 4 H, 0 R, 0 ER, 1 BB, 7 K. 96 pitches, 70 strikes, 22 swing/miss Erik Miller has the seventh
posts.jp: トールは本日出場終了。1回表で完璧な回を記録、空振り22個。今季レッドソックス投手で2番目。トールの8月7日の24空振りが最多。6回、4安打、0失点、1四死球、7奪三振。96球、70ストライク、22空振り。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Pete Alonso is on the verge of 300 career home runs, a mark only 170 players have reached. His response is everything you'd expect. "I mean, yeah, great, awesome. But, today, I got my 100th RBI. Whoop-de-do. Didn’t win the game. I play to win," Alonso said.
posts.jp: ピート・アロンソがキャリア300ホームラン目前。170人のみが到達したこの記録への彼のコメントは予想通り。「まあ、素晴らしい。でも今日は100打点に達した。勝つことが重要。勝つためにプレーする」とアロンソ。

posts.author: Will Sammon
posts.text: The Mets are promoting top prospect Jefferson Rojas to Triple A, league sources said. In 135 plate appearances with Double-A Binghamton following trade from Cubs to Mets, Rojas had a .929 OPS with 9 home runs.
posts.jp: メッツが有力ルーキー、ジェファーソン・ロハスをトリプルAに昇格。キューバスからメッツにトレードされた後、ダブルAビンガムトンで135打席出場時に0.929のOPS、9ホームラン。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: AJ Blubaugh is the first major-league reliever in two years to throw 90 innings out of the bullpen without making a start. He's the first Astros reliever to do it since Brad Lidge threw 94.2 innings in 2004.
posts.jp: AJブルバーフは2年ぶりにリリーフ投手として先発なしでシーズン90イニングを投げた。アストロズではブラッド・リッジが2004年に94.2イニングを投げて以来。
